name: What is the process for shower installation with CG Plumbing Solutions?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for shower installation with CG Plumbing Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our shower installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and on-site assessment to understand your needs and bathroom specifications. Next, we provide a detailed estimate and project plan. Upon approval, our skilled technicians handle all aspects of the installation, including demolition, plumbing rough-in, shower unit placement, waterproofing, and finish work. We aim for clear communication throughout the project, ensuring minimal disruption and a smooth installation from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, detailed estimate, demolition, plumbing rough-in, unit placement, waterproofing, and finish work. We ensure clear communication throughout the project.
